title: The Minimum Wage as an Anchor: Effects on Determinations of Fairness by Humans and AI
reasoning: The paper investigates the perception of fairness in wage determination by both humans and AI. By evaluating how an LLM makes judgments about what constitutes a 'fair' wage and analyzing biases related to gender and race in these determinations, the paper contains a significant component related to evaluating moral/ethical concepts of fairness and equity.
